findings.title: Quotient-ray normalization in explicit face operators

decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.witness: Simple singular lattice triangle; projected normals+1,-2 versus primitive ordinary Star+1,-1. Exact closed7/4 versus2,open1/4 versus0.
decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.repair_limit: 2*d3 or correctly introduced nonprimitive quotient construction repairs example; general corrected coordinate formula not claimed.
decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.counterevidence: Global Brion/Todd and leading face fundamental class pass;7.12/7.13 needs only leading component.

native_core_evidence_unchanged.kind: False explicit face operator in allowed singular simple polytopes
native_core_evidence_unchanged.suggested_severity: Major; primary reviewer assigns final numbering and severity
locations: pp.80–81, corresponding weighted face formulas at y=0
native_core_evidence_unchanged.exact_hypotheses: P=conv{(0,0),(2,0),(0,1)} is a full-dimensional simple lattice triangle. E={x=0,0<=y<=1}; primitive inward normals are (1,0),(0,1),(-1,-2). The ray sigma=(1,0) has multiplicity 1. Star(sigma) lies in Z^2/Z(1,0)=Z and has primitive rays +1,-1, so V_sigma=P^1 and G_Star is trivial.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.decisive_calculation: P(h) has volume V=(2+h1+2h2+h3)^2/4. The printed closed operator is d1 Q(d2)Q(d3), Q(t)=t/(1-exp(-t)); its exact value is 7/4, while E has 2 lattice points. The printed dual operator has value 1/4, while Relint(E) has none. After mandatory d1, only constant and linear Todd terms can contribute, so no truncation uncertainty is present.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.interpretation_check: The original adjacent rays project to +1 and -2. The source explicitly defines primitive generators and the saturated Star lattice, but pp.74–75 substitute unchanged ambient divisor classes and ambient h derivatives. Their shorthand for adjacent ambient ray labels is not a stated nonprimitive-stacky convention or a change in face measure.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.correction_direction: Use intrinsic invariant divisor classes of the quotient fan and translate them correctly to ambient restrictions/derivatives. In this example the hypotenuse class/derivative needs the factor 2. A complete general corrected formula is not claimed here.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.scope_and_counterevidence: Refutes the displayed explicit face lattice-count operators; at y=0 this also affects weighted/normalized singular face variants. It does not refute global Todd/Brion identities, abstract HRR with the actual class, or the face integral fundamental-class identity. The same triangle's global formula passes exact checks.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.alternative_interpretation_test: If one instead keeps nonprimitive quotient weights +1,-2 and introduces the associated stacky Cox stabilizer, an extra element with adjacent characters (1,-1) contributes +(1/2)*d1*d3(V)=+1/4 to the closed operator and -1/4 to the dual operator, repairing the numbers. This is useful counterevidence to any claim that no quotient construction can work. It is not the printed ordinary Star fan with primitive generators and saturated quotient lattice; the altered data must be stated and justified. The elementary mixed derivative d1*d3(V)=1/2 was also checked in the retained exact calculations.

findings.severity_reason: False explicit face guarantees under stated simple-lattice hypotheses. The correction requires an explicit quotient-lattice interpretation, not an unstated smoothness restriction.

findings.title: Ambient prefactor in unnormalized weighted proper-face formula

decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.counterevidence: Separately printed normalizedpointoperator gives1. This witness does not refute6.18; P01 at y0 is distinct.

native_core_evidence_unchanged.kind: Ambient dimension/ray prefactor in unnormalized weighted face operator
native_core_evidence_unchanged.suggested_severity: Major mathematical normalization component; may be grouped with F01 by the primary
native_core_evidence_unchanged.exact_hypotheses: Take the smooth interval P=[0,1], face E={0}, f=1, y=1. Ambient n=1,r=2. The Star fan of a vertex has dimension 0 and no rays.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.decisive_calculation: V(h)=1+h_left+h_right. The printed operator is (1+y)^(-1) d_left, so (6.17) gives 1/2 at y=1, whereas the weighted lattice count of a point is 1. Independently, the left edge of the smooth unit square gives printed value 1 versus weighted endpoint count 2 at y=1.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.correction_direction: The unnormalized intrinsic class requires exponent dim(V_sigma)-|Star(sigma)(1)| rather than ambient n-r, together with the quotient normalization required in singular cases.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.scope_and_counterevidence: The normalized operator printed separately after (6.17) drops the prefactor and is not disproved by this smooth point/edge witness. Its purported derivation from the printed unnormalized expression is inconsistent. Do not claim the smooth prefactor witness refutes Corollary 6.8; the independent singular quotient-ray witness still applies there at y=0.

findings.title: Vertex translation repeated in local Euler-Maclaurin formulas

decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.witness: P[1,2],v1,realz<0 near0. ExactQ(dh)I=e^z/(1-e^z); extraexpv gives e^(2z)/(1-e^z). q99/100 gives99 versus9801/100. Interior/weighted versions share cause.
decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.repair: Remove outerexpv from translated sum or use unshiftedCv.
decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.counterevidence: General Proposition5.22 is distinct from equation5.22; globalBrion4.19 uses only one shift. Valid convergence chamber, no divergent-boundary objection.

native_core_evidence_unchanged.kind: Repeated extra vertex translation in explicit local EM formulas
native_core_evidence_unchanged.suggested_severity: Major correctness correction to the printed local formulas; primary assigns final severity
native_core_evidence_unchanged.exact_hypotheses: P=[1,2], v=1, C_v=[0,infinity), Tan(P,v)=[1,infinity), Tan(P,v)(h)=[1-h,infinity). Take real z<0 arbitrarily close to 0, satisfying all local convergence conditions.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.decisive_calculation: The integral is -exp((1-h)z)/z. Applying Q(d_h) gives exp(z)/(1-exp(z)); the printed right side multiplies the already translated lattice sum by another exp(z), yielding exp(2z)/(1-exp(z)). For q=exp(z)=99/100 the two values are 99 and 9801/100. Interior and weighted y=1 versions have the same extra ratio q.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.interpretation_check: Page 66 explicitly defines Tan(P,v)=v+C_v, and Theorem 5.8 repeats that definition. Thus Tan is not secretly unshifted. Equation (4.19) and Proposition 5.22 use the legitimate single shift multiplying an unshifted cone/local class.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.correction_direction: Remove the external exp(<v,z>) when the sum is over Tan(P,v), or retain it and sum over the corresponding unshifted cone/faces.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.scope_and_counterevidence: Equation (5.22) is not Proposition 5.22. The general proposition and the global formulas are not refuted by this local repeated translation error.

findings.severity_reason: Five displayed local application identities fail under stated hypotheses. Grouped as one mathematical error; a short factor correction alone does not downgrade a false central explicit guarantee.

findings.title: False Cox group product in two local proofs
source_locators: p61 repeated product in the alternative localization proof

decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.witness: G=Cstar connected,H=mu2,soG cannot be H timesCstar; squaremap has no integer-exponentsection.
decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.repair: Invariant monomial restriction with unique Laurent extension, residualT action and dlog wedge factor proves required local identification. Finite stabilizer average retained.
decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence.counterevidence: The group witness is not a counterexample to characteristic classes. Explicit replacement preservesLemma3.20/localformula and supports3.36, conditional on stated earlier finitequotient/localization inputs.

native_core_evidence_unchanged.kind: False algebraic-group splitting used in two proofs
native_core_evidence_unchanged.suggested_severity: Local proof gap requiring repair; primary assigns final severity
native_core_evidence_unchanged.exact_hypotheses: For the triangle fan with rays (1,0),(0,1),(-1,-2), the Cox map is (t1,t2,t3)->(t1/t3,t2/t3^2). Hence G={(t,t^2,t)} is connected C*. For the cone generated by first and third rays, G_sigma=mu_2.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.decisive_calculation: The claimed product G_sigma x (C*)^(r-n)=mu_2 x C* is disconnected, so it cannot equal G. Equivalently, the exact sequence 1->mu_2->C* --square-->C*->1 would need an integer character splitting 2k=1.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.correction_direction: Replace the false product argument by a valid slice quotient or suitable isogeny/rational equivariant argument. A full replacement proof is not supplied here.
native_core_evidence_unchanged.scope_and_counterevidence: The source explicitly advertises an alternative localization proof, but p.61 repeats the same splitting assertion. Record both occurrences rather than claim the alternative removes it. The characteristic-class formula itself has no counterexample from this witness; exact global and local Molien checks support the formulas in the tested singular example.

findings.severity_reason: Major: the false Cox-group product is an essential local-descent bridge in the original proof of Lemma 3.20 and hence the main equivariant characteristic-class formula of Theorem 3.21 (p.43). The alternative localization derivation repeats the same invalid splitting on p.61, so it does not independently remove this core proof gap. The verified invariant-monomial replacement restores the result without splitting the finite-kernel sequence. No counterexample to the characteristic-class identity is inferred; the severity concerns the original invalid core derivation.
